name: Villa de Porres B&B

tagline.en: A friendly family B&B in Bearna, close to Galway Bay, with a warm welcome and a breakfast guests remember.
tagline.ga: B&B teaghlaigh cairdiúil i mBearna, gar do Chuan na Gaillimhe, le fáilte chroíúil agus bricfeasta a fhanann i gcuimhne na n-aíonna.

mapQuery: Villa de Porres B&B, Bearna, Co. Galway

en: Villa de Porres is a family-run B&B in Bearna, just west of Galway city and close to the shore of Galway Bay.
Guests praise the hosts and the breakfast. It’s an easy base for Galway city, Spiddal and the Connemara coast road, with Wi-Fi and parking.
ga: Is B&B teaghlaigh é Villa de Porres i mBearna, díreach siar ó chathair na Gaillimhe agus gar do chladach Chuan na Gaillimhe.
Molann aíonna na hóstaigh agus an bricfeasta. Is bonn éasca é do chathair na Gaillimhe, don Spidéal agus do bhóthar an chósta i gConamara, le Wi-Fi agus páirceáil.
